texts.error.font_not_found: The TTF font %1 was not found (the core uses no font of the computer's).
texts.error.font_not_loaded: The TTF font %1 could not be loaded: %2
texts.error.game_zip_unreadable: The game's zip (%1) could not be read: %2. Give the zip of an Ikemen GO game folder.
texts.error.gl_context: The core could not make an OpenGL 3.3 context of %1x%2 (%3).
texts.error.save_data_unusable: The project's save data could not be used: %1
texts.error.save_name_outside: %1: "%2" is not a name inside the game's folder.
texts.property.animation: The animation the fighter shows (its .air action number)
texts.property.fighter_state: The state the fighter is in (its .cns state number)
texts.property.life_max: The most life the fighter can have
texts.property.match_frame: Frames the engine has run since it started
texts.property.match_random_seed: The engine's random number generator's state: every random choice (AI, a random character or stage, Lua's math.random) comes from it
texts.property.match_round_time: Time left in the round, in ticks (60 a second); -1 for no time limit
texts.property.match_wins: Rounds won by each side ([0] player 1's side, [1] player 2's)
texts.property.power_max: The most power the fighter can have
texts.property.present: Whether this player has a fighter in the match
texts.property.red_life: Red life (recoverable life, in tag modes)
texts.property.velocity_x: Speed across the stage, in the direction the fighter faces
texts.property.velocity_y: Speed up or down (negative is up)
texts.property.x: Position: across the stage, from its middle
texts.property.y: Position: height above the floor (negative is up)
texts.property.z: Position: depth, on stages that have one
texts.setting.starttime.about: The date and time the game reads when it starts, in seconds since 1970 (Unix time), in UTC; it then runs with the frames, 1/60 of a second each. Ikemen GO also seeds its random numbers (a random stage, a random character, the AI's choices) from it as it starts. The default is the first of January 2000. This is a setting, and not your computer's clock, so that a movie plays back the same on any day. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.game.help: The game: an Ikemen GO game folder (the one holding chars/, stages/, data/ and the rest, as an Ikemen GO release unpacks), zipped. The zip may hold the folder itself or its contents. What the core does not find in it - the engine's own data/, external/ and font/ files - it brings itself, from the Ikemen GO it is built with.
texts.slot.savedata.help: What the game wrote, as Game > Export Save Data gave it: the .zip of the files with their folders (save/config.ini, save/stats.json...), or a single file, which goes into save/. They are put in the game's folder before it starts.
